title: Ops Inbox Triage Bot
one_liner: Paste an email and get category, urgency, a one-line summary and a suggested route, validated by pydantic, with the routing shown as simulated log lines.

steps.text: Ops inbox triage: use a sample email
Triage: category, urgency and the route it would take
The summary and the simulated routing log; nothing is sent
Triage all six: category, expected label, match, urgency, route
